description: Coded consumer-remedy TARGET registry entry — one record per remedy kind × jurisdiction, holding the remedy kind / 根拠法令 (statutory or scheme basis) / statutory window (日数, where one exists) / 書面 form / delivery channel / escalation forum so a kurashimori cell can diagnose + (eventually) help draft procedurally (ADR-2605312500 §2). WORLDWIDE/multi-jurisdiction (not JP-only): `jurisdiction` carries an ISO-style country tag (e.g. jpn/usa/deu/fra/gbr/can/aus/ind/sgp/bra/mex/kor) or a supranational stand-in (e.g. eu-wide). OPEN DATA (derived from the authority's published guidance; provenance mandatory). INFORMATIONAL-ONLY: the cooling-off / window output is a date computation, NOT a legal opinion (G5). CONSTITUTIONAL BOUNDARY (every jurisdiction): self-help diagnosis + drafting-assist only — no representation (代理), no claims-buying, no fees/contingency, no official-channel status, no campaigning; 弁護士法 / 司法書士法 / 行政書士法 / UPL and national analogs (German RDG, French monopole de l'avocat, Advocates Act 1961, Legal Profession Act, Law Society Act). CONSTITUTIONAL: `verificationStatus` gates live send (G14) — statutory windows (日数) drift and a wrong 日数 is harmful, so seeds enable diagnosis-design only. Never fabricate (G8): `legalBasis` + `provenance` mandatory.

remedyKind.description: The kind of remedy/route. 'chargeback' = card billing-error / scheme chargeback (consumer-side demand; warifu handles the card-rail side); 'warranty' = statutory guarantee of conformity / lemon-law / consumer-guarantee path (repair / replace / refund). knownValues, not closed — R0 permissive.

statutoryWindowDays.description: Statutory window in days (cooling-off/return); 0 if N/A. A WRONG value is harmful — G14 verify.

windowStart.description: 起算日 description (when the clock starts)

formRef.description: chigiri template id used to compose this remedy

deliveryChannel.description: How the notice is sent (内容証明 / 電子 / portal / 電話)

escalationForum.description: Where to escalate if self-help stalls

legalBasis.description: 根拠法令 — MANDATORY (G8), e.g. '特定商取引法 §9'

verificationStatus.description: G14 send gate. unverified-seed => diagnosis-design only, NO live send.
